new_interfaces.gap: The stated reason that the primal maximum is finite and closed does not alone prove closedness of the dual finite convex envelope. Compact conjugate domains allow a direct attainment/closedness proof.
A bounded noncompact continuous test requires tightness, not only vague convergence. The functions and limit have the same full mass; a cutoff proves the exact needed passage.
